name: Born Again
title: Daredevil #230
desc:
While Matt is being nursed back to help by Sister Maggie, he discovers a secret about her that will change their relationship forever! Meanwhile, Kingpin commissions a Daredevil costume...

Matt is saved and treated by some nuns while Karen Page runs away with a drug dealer and Kingpin trains to face Daredevil again. Ben Urich was attacked but continues to investigate Matt's disappearance, even with Kingpin's guys threatening him. Karen regrets what she did and tries to call Matt but Foggy answer her call and tries to help her. Foggy tells Karen Matt is gone for days, and she says it is all her fault. Someone is fashioning a duplicate of Daredevil's outfit.

At the end Matt realize that the nun who has been helping him is his mother.
